rule.name: Null pointers should not be dereferenced

descriptionSections.content: A reference to null should never be dereferenced/accessed.

A reference to null should never be dereferenced/accessed. Doing so will cause a NullPointerException to be thrown. At best, such an exception will cause abrupt program termination. At worst, it could expose debugging information that would be useful to an attacker.

Even worse, exceptions of this kind can hide the real reason a program fails.

Check the variable for null before dereferencing it.

if (foo != null) {
  foo.bar();
}

Or use the Optional pattern when available.
